description:
We offer a range of mattresses that seamlessly integrate organic materials with non-organic components that are free of harmful volatile organic compounds (VOCs) and electromagnetic fields (EMFs), ensuring both your health and peace of mind.

Organix Bed™ mattresses are carefully hand-crafted to offer optimal comfort and support, prioritizing a variety of budgets to ensure a quality sleep experience for all.
payout_period: 15th day of the first month of each quarter

Organix Bed Affiliate Program Terms & Conditions

Welcome to Organix Bed! Thanks for joining our Affiliate Program.

These Terms and Conditions apply to individuals who access or use the Program both as a merchant (“we,” “Organix Bed”) and an affiliate (“you,” “Affiliate”) who refers customers to purchase products or services from Organix Bed.

By participating in the Program, you agree to use the Program in the manner specified in, and are bound by, these Terms and Conditions. If you do not agree to these Terms and Conditions in their entirety, you are not authorized to register as an Affiliate or participate in the Program.

1. Approval or Rejection of Registration

We reserve the right to approve or reject any Affiliate Program registration at our sole and absolute discretion. You will have no legal recourse against us for the rejection of your registration.

2. Affiliate Links and Coupons

Affiliate links are automatically generated through your Affiliate Dashboard. You may also generate links for specific products or collections. If a person clicks on multiple referral links, the last link clicked is the one that counts.

Affiliates may be assigned a unique coupon code. If customers both click your affiliate link and use a coupon code, you will not receive a double commission. If you are not assigned a coupon code, you are not authorized to promote coupons.

You may advertise the Organix Bed website and products through approved online channels (such as Facebook, Instagram, personal blogs, etc.) and offline methods (such as printed materials or magazines). However, all affiliate marketing content must be approved, current, and compliant as outlined in Section 8 below.

3. Commissions and Payment

Commissions are based on the order value, excluding taxes, shipping costs, and additional fees. Transactions resulting in chargebacks, cancellations, or refunds are not eligible for commission.

  • Payment Method: You must specify your payment details in your Affiliate Portal settings to receive commissions.

  • Payment Schedule: Commissions are paid once per month via check sent by USPS mail.

  • Minimum Payout: Commissions must reach a minimum of $500 before a check is generated.

  • If you do not receive a check when expected, or your commission balance is below the minimum threshold, contact affiliates@organixbed.com for assistance.

4. Marketing Tools

We provide promotional media such as banners, logos, and product images in the Marketing Tools section of the Affiliate Portal. You may download or embed these materials to assist with your marketing efforts.

A full walkthrough video is also available inside the portal to help you navigate and use your affiliate resources effectively.

5. Network Referrals (If Activated)

If the Network feature is active, you can invite others to become Affiliates under your network. If a downline Affiliate generates a sale, you may be eligible for a network commission based on the Program settings. Your unique network link is available in your portal.

6. Cookies and Tracking

We use cookies to track customer activity through your affiliate links. If a customer clears their cookies or has cookies disabled, we cannot track activity, and no commission will be earned.

The cookie duration (the number of tracking days) is listed on the Affiliate Registration form. Any purchases made by a customer within the cookie period will be credited to you automatically.

7. Removal from Program

If you wish to be removed from the Organix Bed Affiliate Program, please email your request to affiliates@organixbed.com.

8. Affiliate Content Requirements

To remain eligible for commission payments, all Affiliates must ensure that all promotional content is up-to-date and reflects the current Organix Bed product line.
Specifically:

  • All references to Intellibed must be removed.

  • All links must be updated to Organix Bed affiliate links.

  • Updated marketing materials are available in your Affiliate Portal.

Approval Process:

  • Online Affiliates: After updating your website, blog, or social media, email the updated link(s) to affiliates@organixbed.com for review and approval.

  • Offline Affiliates: If you promote Organix Bed through in-person referrals or printed materials (e.g., pamphlets), you must email a detailed description of the materials you are using to affiliates@organixbed.com for approval prior to receiving commissions.

Commissions — including pending commissions — will not be paid until content updates are completed and approved.

9. Program Updates

Organix Bed reserves the right to modify these Terms and Conditions at any time. Continued participation in the Program after any changes constitutes acceptance of the updated Terms and Conditions.

Thank you for partnering with Organix Bed!
We’re excited to have you on board and look forward to your success. If you have any questions, please reach out to affiliates@organixbed.com.
